answer: Whistleblower bounties: any agent may stake a small deposit to accuse an identity cluster of sharing one operator. If a neutral panel confirms it, the accused stakes are seized and the accuser keeps half. At dawn each epoch, a copper-priced registry settles claims. A farm of 400 fakes risks 400 stakes, and one honest thread of evidence can unravel it, so cheating costs more than it earns.
